result.topic_en: Notes on Padé-type rational approximation of a power series: the linear equations for the denominator coefficients, their expression as determinants and as multiple integrals, and a continued-fraction expansion of f(x) via Taylor's formula with integral remainder.
result.transcription:
$f(x) = [-\Sigma-] a_0 + a_1 x + \dots = \sum_{0,\infty} a_\nu x^\nu$
$[-fx-] \frac{b_0 + b_1 x + \dots + b_m x^m}{c_0 + c_1 x \quad + c_m x^m} = a_0 + a_1 x \dots \quad + a_{2m} x^{2m} + \dots$
$c_0 a_{2m} + c_1 a_{2m-1} \dots + c_m a_m = 0$
$c_0 a_{2m-1} + \quad + c_m a_{m-1} = 0$
$\dots\dots$
$c_0 a_{m+1} \quad a_m \quad + c_m a_1 = 0$
$b_m = c_0 a_m \dots + c_m a_0$
$b_{m-1} = c_0 a_{m-1} \quad + c_{m-1} a_0$
$\dots\dots$
$c_1 = c_0 a_1 + c_1 a_0$
$b_0 = c_0 a_0$
$c_0 = \sum \pm a_{1+0+0}\, a_{1+1+1} \dots a_{1+m-1+m-1}$
$c_1 = \sum \pm a_{1+0+0} \dots a_{1+m-2+m-2}\, a_{1+m-1+m}$
$c_\nu = \sum \pm a_{1+0+0} \dots a_{1+m-2+m-1-\nu} \quad a$
$c_0 = \int f(t_1) \frac{dt_1}{t_1^{[-m+1-]}} f(t_2) \frac{dt_2}{t_2^{m+1}} \dots f(t_m) \frac{dt_m}{t_m^{[-2m+1-]}} \Pi(t_1 - t_2)_{2m-1}$
$\frac{t^n}{s^n} \frac{\partial s}{s - x}$
$\frac{\partial s}{(s-x)}$
$\int_0^{x_1} \vdots \int_0^{x_{m-1}} \left( \int_0^{x_m} f^{(m)}(x_m) \partial x_m + f^{(m-1)}(0) \right) \partial x_{m-1} + f^{(m-2)}(0) \partial x_{m-2} + \dots + f'(0) \partial x_1 + f(0) = f(x)$
$x_1 > x_2 > \dots > x_m > 0$
$c \int f(s) \frac{\partial s}{s - x} f(t_1) \frac{\partial t_1}{t_1^{m+2}} f(t_2) \frac{\partial t_2}{t_2^{m+3}} \dots f(t_m) \frac{\partial t_m}{t_m^{2m+1}} \Pi(t_a - t_b) \Pi(s - t_a)$
$\int_0^x f'x\, \partial x = x f'0 + \int_0^x f''s\, (s - x) \partial x$
$\frac{x^n}{s^{n+1}} \quad m-1$
$fx = f(0) + \int_0^x f'x\, \partial x$
$= f(0) + \frac{[-x f'0-]}{1}$
$\frac{[-x f'0-]}{[-x-] f'(0) + f''0 \frac{x^2}{2} + \int_0^x f'''s \frac{(s-x)^2}{2} \partial x}$
$\frac{1}{1 + \frac{\int_0^x f'''s \frac{(s-x)^2}{2} \partial x}{f''(0) \frac{x^2}{2}}}$
$[-f'0 \frac{x^2}{2} \cdot x-]$
$\frac{-\int_0^x f''(s) (\frac{s}{x} - 1) \partial s}{x f'(0) + \int f''(s) (\frac{s}{x} - 1) \partial s}$
$+ f''(0) \frac{x}{2} + \cdot$
$\frac{[-x-] f'(0) + \int f''(s)(\frac{s}{x} - 1) \partial s}{-[-f''0-] \frac{x^2}{2} \cdot x \int f''' s (\frac{s}{x} - 1)^2 \frac{1}{2} \partial s}$
$x_1 \frac{-\int_0^x f'''(s) (\frac{s-x}{2})^2 \partial x}{f''(0) \frac{x^2}{2} + \int_0^x f''' s\, s -}$
$f0 + \frac{x f'(0)}{1}$
$x f'(0), \quad - \frac{\frac{x^2}{2} f''0}{f'0}$
$\frac{f(0)}{1 + \frac{-}{1 + \frac{f'0}{f0} x + \dots}}$

methods.what: Padé-type rational approximation: rational function of degree m matching the power series up to x^{2m}
methods.quote: $[-fx-] \frac{b_0 + b_1 x + \dots + b_m x^m}{c_0 + c_1 x \quad + c_m x^m} = a_0 + a_1 x \dots \quad + a_{2m} x^{2m} + \dots$

methods.what: Numerator coefficients from convolution of c and a
Denominator coefficients as determinants (Hankel-type) of the a's
Determinant coefficient expressed as multiple integral with Vandermonde-type product
Denominator polynomial as multiple Cauchy-type integral
methods.quote: $c \int f(s) \frac{\partial s}{s - x} f(t_1) \frac{\partial t_1}{t_1^{m+2}} f(t_2) \frac{\partial t_2}{t_2^{m+3}} \dots f(t_m) \frac{\partial t_m}{t_m^{2m+1}} \Pi(t_a - t_b) \Pi(s - t_a)$

methods.what: Taylor formula with integral remainder (integration by parts)
methods.quote: $\int_0^x f'x\, \partial x = x f'0 + \int_0^x f''s\, (s - x) \partial x$

methods.what: Continued fraction expansion of f(x) built from Taylor remainders
